claim: Real plans contain only recipes the household adds; the sample week never reads or changes that data.
where: landing first screen, privacy and limits section, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create real data, enter /demo/, mutate and reset sample data, return to the untouched real namespace

claim: Flags effort mismatches and dinners similar to a school or canteen meal.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ sample week; lower Wednesday energy and assert both visible warnings

claim: Flags a planned dinner that closely repeats a meal from the previous two days.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ sample week; inspect Tuesday and assert the visible warning for repeating Monday's traybake as leftovers

claim: Flags a leftover dinner when no portion is available from an earlier planned dinner.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ sample week; remove Monday's source dinner and assert Tuesday's existing leftover dinner shows the unavailable warning

claim: The sample week opens with exactly three recipes and five planned nights.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ storage; count visible recipe cards and read the visible planned-night summary before any change

claim: Exports planned recipe ingredients as a grocery CSV without placing an order.
where: grocery tool, privacy and limits section, README
sandbox: fresh /demo/ sample week; download and assert the header and rows from all three planned recipes

claim: Exports and imports the complete plan as JSON.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ sample week; export, mutate, import, and assert the original recipes and week return

claim: Planning data stays in browser storage and the planner loads no third-party runtime resources.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; capture the whole flow network, persist a change, reload, and inspect IndexedDB and localStorage namespaces

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; wait for service-worker control, set the browser offline, reload, and assert the sample plan and offline state

claim: The free planner holds eight recipes; a valid $12 one-time license removes that limit.
where: landing facts, purchase card, terms, README
sandbox: enter through /demo/; assert production checkout identity, start with clean real data, reach the free limit, mock a valid product-license verdict, and add a ninth recipe

claim: The free planner opens the current and next week; a valid $12 one-time license opens previous and future weeks.
where: landing facts, purchase card, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo/ entry; prove the free previous and beyond-next controls keep the displayed week unchanged, then start for real, mock a valid license verdict, and navigate before and after the current week

claim: Mark cooked or changed dinners and see both weekly outcome counts update and persist.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ sample week; mark one planned dinner cooked, reload, mark it changed, and assert the cooked and changed summary counts after each saved state
